ns2:section.sectionText: FR 570/MDVL 570 "Survey of Medieval French Literature" This course provides a survey of the major currents, periods, works and authors of the medieval period in France. The reading list includes the works on the MA reading list as well as a selection of other short text - for example, an excerpt from the Roman de Renard, fabliaux, samples of lyric poetry. All works will be read in modern French translation. Mondays, 3-4:50 p.m., classroom TBD Instructor: K. Fresco kfresco@illinois.edu
